title: June and the Bakery That Went for a Walk
synopsis: A turtle carries a tiny bakery on her shell, so the shop visits its customers and finds a quiet place under an apple tree.

related_resources.reason: A simple and repeated premise supports playful anticipation without requiring a listener to master the idea of a fixed shop.
A concrete return to a quieter scene closes the fiction; the reading guidance pertains to how families might share the story, not sleep outcomes.
